<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>OM Portal · Universal Infrastructure Substrate</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><text y='.9em' font-size='90'>⬡</text></svg>">
  <link rel="search" type="application/opensearchdescription+xml" href="/opensearch.xml" title="Universal Dashboard Search">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-base: #07090e;
      --card-bg: rgba(18, 24, 38, 0.65);
      --card-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
      --card-hover-border: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
      --card-hover-bg: rgba(26, 35, 54, 0.85);
      --accent: #38bdf8;
      --accent-glow: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
      --accent-purple: #818cf8;
      --online: #10b981;
      --online-glow: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35);
      --stopped: #94a3b8;
      --crashed: #f43f5e;
      --text: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --text-dim: #64748b;
      --nav-bg: rgba(10, 14, 22, 0.82);
      --wp-blur: 0px;
      --wp-dim: 0.20;
      --card-blur: 16px;
      --card-dim: 0.65;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 14px;
      --radius-lg: 18px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    body {
      background: var(--bg-base);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      position: relative;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    /* ── 1. Independent Wallpaper Layering (Decoupled from Glass) ── */
    #wallpaper-layer {
      position: fixed;
      top: -25px;
      left: -25px;
      right: -25px;
      bottom: -25px;
      z-index: 0;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center center;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      image-rendering: high-quality;
      filter: blur(var(--wp-blur, 0px)) brightness(calc(1 - var(--wp-dim, 0.20)));
      transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1.04);
      contain: strict;
      will-change: transform;
      backface-visibility: hidden;
      transition: background-image 0.4s ease-in-out, filter 0.3s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    #wallpaper-vignette {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      z-index: 1;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(7, 9, 14, 0.15) 0%, rgba(7, 9, 14, 0.65) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: min(1, calc(var(--wp-dim, 0.20) * 5));
    }

    .dashboard-main {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      max-width: 1560px;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 1.5rem 2rem 3rem 2rem;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* ── 2. Sleek Modern Header ── */
    header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
      background: var(--nav-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      gap: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.85rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--text);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .brand:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

    .brand-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5e9, #38bdf8);
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
    }
    .brand-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: #fff; }

    .brand-title {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .brand-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* ── 3. Command Palette Search Bar (Dedicated Service Filter) ── */
    .search-wrapper {
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 580px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .search-box {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    }
    .search-box:focus-within {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px var(--accent-glow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }
    .search-icon {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      opacity: 0.8;
      user-select: none;
    }
    #search-input {
      flex: 1;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      color: var(--text);
      caret-color: var(--accent);
    }
    #search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 0.85rem; }

    .kbd-shortcut {
      font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      user-select: none;
    }

    /* ── 4. Header Actions & Status Pill ── */
    .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

    .status-pill {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--online);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .pulse-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--online);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--online-glow);
      animation: pulse 2.2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.85); }
    }

    .time-widget {
      font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      display: none;
    }
    @media (min-width: 992px) { .time-widget { display: block; } }

    .btn-action {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.42rem 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .btn-action:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    }
    .btn-label-desktop { display: none; }
    @media (min-width: 600px) { .btn-label-desktop { display: inline; } }
    .dropzone-box.dragover { border-color: var(--accent); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); }

    /* ── 5. World-Class Overview & Infrastructure Metrics Strip ── */
    .overview-strip {
      display: grid;

  <script>
    // ── Global State ──
    function escHtml(str) {
      if (str === null || str === undefined) return '';
      return String(str)
        .replace(/&/g, '&')
        .replace(/</g, '<')
        .replace(/>/g, '>')
        .replace(/"/g, '"')
        .replace(/'/g, ''');
    }

    let allLoadedServices = [];
    let registeredWorkspaces = [];
    let selectedWorkspace = 'all';
    let isScopedSubdomain = false;
    let detectedWorkspaceId = null;
    let savedSettings = { name: '', blur: 0, dim: 20, card_blur: 16, card_dim: 65, timestamp: 0 };
    let previewState = null;
    let isPublicScope = false;

    // Detect workspace from hostname (e.g. containers.dashboard.localhost, container.dashboard.localhost)
    const hostParts = window.location.hostname.split('.');
    document.querySelector('.btn-return-universal').href = `http://localhost${window.location.port ? ':' + window.location.port : ''}/`;
    if (hostParts.length >= 3 && hostParts[1] === 'dashboard' && hostParts[2] === 'localhost') {
      detectedWorkspaceId = hostParts[0].toLowerCase();
      isScopedSubdomain = true;
      selectedWorkspace = detectedWorkspaceId;
    }

    // ── Live Digital Clock ──
    function updateClock() {
      const now = new Date();
      const el = document.getElementById('time-display');
      if (el) el.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: false });
    }
    setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
    updateClock();

    // ── Keyboard Shortcuts (Ctrl+K or /) ──
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if ((e.key === '/' || ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k')) && document.activeElement.tagName !== 'INPUT') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = document.getElementById('search-input');
        if (input) { input.focus(); input.select(); }
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const input = document.getElementById('search-input');
        if (document.activeElement === input) {
          input.value = '';
          filterServices('');
          input.blur();
        }
      }
    });

    function handleSearchKey(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const visibleCards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.service-card')).filter(c => c.style.display !== 'none');
        if (visibleCards.length > 0 && visibleCards[0].href) {
          window.location.href = visibleCards[0].href;
        }
      }
    }

    // ── Load Workspaces & Configure Subdomain Scoping ──
    async function loadWorkspaces() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/workspaces${selectedWorkspace !== 'all' ? '?workspace=' + encodeURIComponent(selectedWorkspace) : ''}`);
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.is_public_scope) {
          isPublicScope = true;
          const tabs = document.getElementById('workspace-tabs');
          if (tabs) tabs.style.display = 'none';

          const strip = document.getElementById('overview-strip');
          if (strip) strip.style.display = 'none';

          const themeBtn = document.getElementById('theme-btn');
          if (themeBtn) themeBtn.style.display = 'none';

          document.title = 'OM Portal · Public Ingress';
          const sub = document.getElementById('portal-subtitle');
          if (sub) sub.textContent = 'Public Portal';

          const gridTitle = document.getElementById('grid-header-title');
          if (gridTitle) gridTitle.textContent = 'Public Services';

          const countEl = document.getElementById('service-count');
          if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${data.total_running} Online`;

          return;
        }

        registeredWorkspaces = data.workspaces || [];

        // Update Overview Stats
        const statWs = document.getElementById('stat-workspaces');
        const statWsSub = document.getElementById('stat-workspaces-sub');
        if (statWs) statWs.textContent = `${registeredWorkspaces.length}`;
        if (statWsSub) statWsSub.textContent = registeredWorkspaces.map(w => w.name).join(', ') || 'Isolated Environments';

        // Check if on a scoped subdomain URL
        if (isScopedSubdomain) {
          // Resolve fuzzy match (e.g. container -> containers)
          const matchedWs = registeredWorkspaces.find(w =>
            w.id === detectedWorkspaceId ||
            w.id.startsWith(detectedWorkspaceId) ||
            detectedWorkspaceId.startsWith(w.id) ||
            w.id.replace(/s$/, '') === detectedWorkspaceId.replace(/s$/, '')
          );

          if (matchedWs) {
            selectedWorkspace = matchedWs.id;
            document.title = `om · ${matchedWs.name} Workspace`;
            document.getElementById('portal-title').innerHTML = `OM <span style="font-weight:400; opacity:0.65; font-size:0.85em;">· ${escHtml(matchedWs.name)}</span>`;
            document.getElementById('portal-subtitle').textContent = `Workspace Capsule · ${matchedWs.id}`;
            document.getElementById('scoped-workspace-banner').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('scoped-name').textContent = matchedWs.name;
            document.getElementById('scoped-path').textContent = `${matchedWs.path || matchedWs.id} · Ingress: Port ${matchedWs.http_port || 80}`;
            document.getElementById('workspace-tabs').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('overview-strip').style.display = 'none';
            return;
          }
        }

        // Universal Dashboard Mode: Render sleek Segmented Control
        const tabsContainer = document.getElementById('workspace-tabs');
        if (!tabsContainer) return;
        tabsContainer.style.display = 'flex';
        tabsContainer.innerHTML = '';

        // "Universal (All)" Pill
        const totalRunning = data.total_running || allLoadedServices.filter(s => s.state === 'running').length;
        const allPill = document.createElement('button');
        allPill.dataset.wsId = 'all';
        allPill.className = 'ws-pill' + (selectedWorkspace === 'all' ? ' active' : '');
        allPill.innerHTML = `<span>🌐 Universal</span><span class="ws-pill-badge">${escHtml(totalRunning)} Online</span>`;
        allPill.onclick = async () => {
          selectedWorkspace = 'all';
          document.title = 'OM Portal · Universal Substrate';
          document.getElementById('portal-title').textContent = 'OM Portal';
          document.getElementById('portal-subtitle').textContent = 'Universal Substrate';
          updateWorkspacePills();
          renderServices();
          await loadSavedWallpaper();
        };
        tabsContainer.appendChild(allPill);

        // Per-Workspace Pills
        registeredWorkspaces.forEach(ws => {
          const pill = document.createElement('button');
          pill.dataset.wsId = ws.id;
          pill.className = 'ws-pill' + (selectedWorkspace === ws.id ? ' active' : '');
          pill.innerHTML = `<span>📁 ${escHtml(ws.name)}</span><span class="ws-pill-badge">${escHtml(ws.running)} Online</span>`;
          pill.onclick = async () => {
            selectedWorkspace = ws.id;
            document.title = `om · ${ws.name} Workspace`;
            document.getElementById('portal-title').innerHTML = `OM <span style="font-weight:400; opacity:0.65; font-size:0.85em;">· ${escHtml(ws.name)}</span>`;
            document.getElementById('portal-subtitle').textContent = `Workspace Capsule · ${ws.id}`;
            updateWorkspacePills();
            renderServices();
            await loadSavedWallpaper();
          };
          tabsContainer.appendChild(pill);
        });

      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Failed to load workspaces:', err);
      }
    }

    function updateWorkspacePills() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.ws-pill').forEach(pill => {
        pill.classList.toggle('active', pill.dataset.wsId === selectedWorkspace);
      });
    }

    // ── Render Services Bento Grid ──
    function renderServices() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('services-grid');
      const activeBadge = document.getElementById('active-badge');
      const serviceCountEl = document.getElementById('service-count');
      const statRunning = document.getElementById('stat-running');
      if (!grid) return;

      let services = allLoadedServices;
      if (selectedWorkspace !== 'all') {
        services = allLoadedServices.filter(s => {
          const sid = (s.workspace_id || '').toLowerCase();
          return sid === selectedWorkspace;
        });
      }

      const runningCount = services.filter(s => s.state === 'running').length;
      const totalCount = services.length;

      // Compute Total RAM across running workloads
      let totalMemBytes = 0;
      services.forEach(s => {
        if (s.state === 'running' && s.memory_usage) {
          totalMemBytes += s.memory_usage;
        }
      });
      const totalMemStr = totalMemBytes > 0
        ? (totalMemBytes >= 1024**3
            ? `${(totalMemBytes / (1024**3)).toFixed(2)} GB RAM`
            : `${(totalMemBytes / (1024**2)).toFixed(1)} MB RAM`)
        : 'Active & Healthy';

      // Update Header Badges & Metrics
      if (isPublicScope) {
        if (activeBadge) activeBadge.textContent = `${runningCount} Available`;
        if (serviceCountEl) serviceCountEl.textContent = `${runningCount} Online`;
      } else {
        if (activeBadge) activeBadge.textContent = `${runningCount}/${totalCount} Online`;
        if (serviceCountEl) serviceCountEl.textContent = `${runningCount} Online • ${totalCount} Total`;
        if (statRunning) statRunning.textContent = `${runningCount} / ${totalCount}`;
        const statRunningSub = document.getElementById('stat-running-sub');
        if (statRunningSub) statRunningSub.textContent = `Total: ${totalMemStr}`;
      }

      grid.innerHTML = '';
      if (services.length === 0) {
        const noResultsDesc = document.querySelector('#no-results p');
        if (noResultsDesc) {
          noResultsDesc.textContent = isPublicScope ? 'No public services are currently available on this network.' : 'Try a different keyword or switch workspaces using the tabs above.';
        }
        document.getElementById('no-results').style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('no-results').style.display = 'none';

      services.forEach(svc => {
        const isRunning = svc.state === 'running';
        const isCrashed = svc.state === 'exited' && svc.exit_code !== 0;
        const hasWeb = svc.has_web !== false;
        const serviceUrl = getServiceUrl(svc);
        const isClickable = isRunning && hasWeb && serviceUrl;

        const card = document.createElement(isClickable ? 'a' : 'div');
        card.className = 'service-card' + (!isRunning ? ' offline' : '') + (!hasWeb ? ' daemon-service' : '');
        if (isClickable) {
          card.href = serviceUrl;
          card.target = '_blank';
          card.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
        }

        let tag = svc.is_public ? 'Public Web' : 'Private Web';
        if (!hasWeb) {
          tag = 'system daemon';
        }

        let stateClass = 'state-running';
        let stateLabel = 'running';
        let stateIcon = '🟢';
        if (!isRunning) {
          if (isCrashed) {
            stateClass = 'state-crashed'; stateLabel = `crashed (${svc.exit_code})`; stateIcon = '⚠️';
          } else if (svc.state === 'paused') {
            stateClass = 'state-paused'; stateLabel = 'paused'; stateIcon = '⏸';
          } else {
            stateClass = 'state-exited'; stateLabel = svc.state || 'stopped'; stateIcon = '⏹';
          }
        }

        const wsPill = (!isPublicScope && svc.workspace_id) ? `<span class="card-ws-pill">📁 ${escHtml(svc.workspace_id)}</span>` : '';

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="card-top">
            <div class="card-icon-title">
              <div class="card-icon-box">${escHtml(svc.icon || '📦')}</div>
              <div>
                <div class="card-name">${escHtml(svc.name)}</div>
                <span class="live-status ${escHtml(stateClass)}">${escHtml(stateIcon)} ${escHtml(stateLabel)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            ${wsPill}
          </div>
          <div class="card-desc">${escHtml(svc.description || 'Self-hosted service')}</div>
          <div class="card-bottom">
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.45rem; flex-wrap:wrap;">
              <span class="card-tag">${escHtml(tag)}</span>
              ${!isPublicScope && isRunning && svc.memory_str && svc.memory_str !== '—' ? `<span class="card-ram-pill" title="Live Container RAM">💾 ${escHtml(svc.memory_str)}</span>` : ''}
              ${!isPublicScope && svc.update_available ? `<span class="card-ram-pill" title="A newer image exists. In the workspace folder: om update --dry-run, then om update">⬆ update</span>` : ''}
            </div>
            ${isClickable ? '<span class="card-arrow">↗</span>' : ''}
          </div>
        `;
        grid.appendChild(card);
      });

      const currentQ = document.getElementById('search-input')?.value;
      if (currentQ) filterServices(currentQ);
    }

    // ── Dedicated Live Container Filter ──
    function filterServices(query) {
      const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.service-card');
      let visible = 0;
      cards.forEach(card => {
        const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
        if (text.includes(q)) {
          card.style.display = 'flex';
          visible++;
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
      document.getElementById('no-results').style.display = visible === 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    // ── Construct Precise RFC 6761 URLs ──
    function getServiceUrl(svc) {
      if (svc.url) return /^(https?:\/\/|\/(?!\/))/i.test(svc.url) ? svc.url : null;
      if (svc.has_web === false) return null;

      const ws = svc.workspace_id || '';
      const key = svc.key || svc.name.toLowerCase();

      const curHost = window.location.hostname;
      if (curHost.endsWith('.localhost') || curHost === 'localhost' || curHost === '127.0.0.1') {
        const port = window.location.port ? `:${window.location.port}` : '';  // OM_HTTP_PORT when not 80
        if (svc.domain) return `http://${svc.domain}${port}/`;
        return ws ? `http://${ws}.${key}.localhost${port}/` : `http://${key}.localhost${port}/`;
      }

      // VPN or LAN: the service's own port, so its own origin (never a path on this one)
      const port = isPublicScope ? svc.port_public : svc.port_private;
      if (!port) return null;
      const host = curHost.includes(':') ? `[${curHost}]` : curHost;
      const path = (svc.path || '/').startsWith('/') ? (svc.path || '/') : `/${svc.path}`;
      return `http://${host}:${port}${path}`;
    }

    // ── Fetch Services ──
    async function loadServices() {
      try {
        const endpoint = `/api/services${selectedWorkspace !== 'all' ? '?workspace=' + encodeURIComponent(selectedWorkspace) : ''}`;
        const res = await fetch(endpoint);
        if (!res.ok) return;
        allLoadedServices = await res.json();
        renderServices();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load services:", err);
      }
    }

    // ── Independent Wallpaper & Visuals Studio (Decoupled from Cards) ──
    function syncSlidersToSettings(settings) {
      if (!settings) return;
      const bVal = (settings.blur !== undefined && settings.blur !== null) ? parseInt(settings.blur, 10) : 0;
      const dVal = (settings.dim !== undefined && settings.dim !== null) ? parseInt(settings.dim, 10) : 20;
      const cbVal = (settings.card_blur !== undefined && settings.card_blur !== null) ? parseInt(settings.card_blur, 10) : 16;
      const cdVal = (settings.card_dim !== undefined && settings.card_dim !== null) ? parseInt(settings.card_dim, 10) : 65;

      const bSlider = document.getElementById('blur-slider');
      const dSlider = document.getElementById('dim-slider');
      const cbSlider = document.getElementById('card-blur-slider');
      const cdSlider = document.getElementById('card-dim-slider');

      if (bSlider) { bSlider.value = bVal; const el = document.getElementById('blur-val'); if (el) el.textContent = `${bVal}px`; }
      if (dSlider) { dSlider.value = dVal; const el = document.getElementById('dim-val'); if (el) el.textContent = `${dVal}%`; }
      if (cbSlider) { cbSlider.value = cbVal; const el = document.getElementById('card-blur-val'); if (el) el.textContent = `${cbVal}px`; }
      if (cdSlider) { cdSlider.value = cdVal; const el = document.getElementById('card-dim-val'); if (el) el.textContent = `${cdVal}%`; }
    }

    function safeWallpaperUrl(url) {
      if (!url) return null;
      if (url.startsWith('/api/wallpaper/') || url.startsWith('blob:')) {
        return url;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function applyVisuals(url, blur, dim, cardBlur, cardDim, updateInputs = false) {
      const wpLayer = document.getElementById('wallpaper-layer');
      if (wpLayer) {
        const safeUrl = safeWallpaperUrl(url);
        if (safeUrl) {
          wpLayer.style.backgroundImage = `url("${safeUrl}")`;
        } else if (url === null || url === '') {
          wpLayer.style.backgroundImage = 'none';
        }
      }
      if (blur !== undefined && blur !== null) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--wp-blur', `${blur}px`);
        if (updateInputs) {
          const s = document.getElementById('blur-slider');
          const v = document.getElementById('blur-val');
          if (s) s.value = blur;
          if (v) v.textContent = `${blur}px`;
        }
      }
      if (dim !== undefined && dim !== null) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--wp-dim', (dim / 100).toFixed(2));
        if (updateInputs) {
          const s = document.getElementById('dim-slider');
          const v = document.getElementById('dim-val');
          if (s) s.value = dim;
          if (v) v.textContent = `${dim}%`;
        }
      }
      if (cardBlur !== undefined && cardBlur !== null) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--card-blur', `${cardBlur}px`);
        if (updateInputs) {
          const s = document.getElementById('card-blur-slider');
          const v = document.getElementById('card-blur-val');
          if (s) s.value = cardBlur;
          if (v) v.textContent = `${cardBlur}px`;
        }
      }
      if (cardDim !== undefined && cardDim !== null) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--card-dim', (cardDim / 100).toFixed(2));
        if (updateInputs) {
          const s = document.getElementById('card-dim-slider');
          const v = document.getElementById('card-dim-val');
          if (s) s.value = cardDim;
          if (v) v.textContent = `${cardDim}%`;
        }
      }
    }

    async function loadSavedWallpaper() {
      try {
        const wsParam = (selectedWorkspace && selectedWorkspace !== 'all') ? `?workspace=${encodeURIComponent(selectedWorkspace)}` : '';
        const res = await fetch(`/api/wallpaper/settings${wsParam}`);
        if (!res.ok) return;
        savedSettings = await res.json();
        
        savedSettings.blur = (savedSettings.blur !== undefined && savedSettings.blur !== null) ? parseInt(savedSettings.blur, 10) : 0;
        savedSettings.dim = (savedSettings.dim !== undefined && savedSettings.dim !== null) ? parseInt(savedSettings.dim, 10) : 20;

    function optimizeImageFile(file, maxWidth = 2560, maxHeight = 1440) {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const img = new Image();
        img.onload = () => {
          let { width, height } = img;
          if (width > maxWidth || height > maxHeight) {
            const ratio = Math.min(maxWidth / width, maxHeight / height);
            width = Math.round(width * ratio);
            height = Math.round(height * ratio);
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = width;
            canvas.height = height;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
            canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
              resolve(blob || file);
            }, 'image/jpeg', 0.88);
            return;
          }
          resolve(file);
        };
        img.onerror = () => resolve(file);
        img.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      });
    }

    async function init() {

  <!-- Wallpaper & Appearance Dialog Modal -->
  <dialog id="wallpaper-dialog">

            <span id="blur-val">0px</span>

            <span>Wallpaper Dimming</span>

    <!-- Permanent Sticky Footer with Always-Visible Save Button -->

      <div class="modal-footer-status">
        <span id="footer-status-label">Active: Current Wallpaper</span>

        <button type="button" class="btn-apply" id="btn-save-appearance">
          <span>💾</span>
          <span>Apply & Save Appearance</span>
        </button>

  <script>
    // ── Global State ──
    function escHtml(str) {
      if (str === null || str === undefined) return '';
      return String(str)
        .replace(/&/g, '&')
        .replace(/</g, '<')
        .replace(/>/g, '>')
        .replace(/"/g, '"')
        .replace(/'/g, ''');
    }

    let allLoadedServices = [];
    let registeredWorkspaces = [];
    let selectedWorkspace = 'all';
    let isScopedSubdomain = false;
    let detectedWorkspaceId = null;
    let savedSettings = { name: '', blur: 0, dim: 20, card_blur: 16, card_dim: 65, timestamp: 0 };
    let previewState = null;
    let isPublicScope = false;

    // Detect workspace from hostname (e.g. containers.dashboard.localhost, container.dashboard.localhost)
    const hostParts = window.location.hostname.split('.');
    document.querySelector('.btn-return-universal').href = `http://localhost${window.location.port ? ':' + window.location.port : ''}/`;
    if (hostParts.length >= 3 && hostParts[1] === 'dashboard' && hostParts[2] === 'localhost') {
      detectedWorkspaceId = hostParts[0].toLowerCase();
      isScopedSubdomain = true;
      selectedWorkspace = detectedWorkspaceId;
    }

    // ── Live Digital Clock ──
    function updateClock() {
      const now = new Date();
      const el = document.getElementById('time-display');
      if (el) el.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: false });
    }
    setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
    updateClock();

    // ── Keyboard Shortcuts (Ctrl+K or /) ──
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if ((e.key === '/' || ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k')) && document.activeElement.tagName !== 'INPUT') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = document.getElementById('search-input');
        if (input) { input.focus(); input.select(); }
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const input = document.getElementById('search-input');
        if (document.activeElement === input) {
          input.value = '';
          filterServices('');
          input.blur();
        }
      }
    });

    function handleSearchKey(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const visibleCards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.service-card')).filter(c => c.style.display !== 'none');
        if (visibleCards.length > 0 && visibleCards[0].href) {
          window.location.href = visibleCards[0].href;
        }
      }
    }

    // ── Load Workspaces & Configure Subdomain Scoping ──
    async function loadWorkspaces() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/workspaces${selectedWorkspace !== 'all' ? '?workspace=' + encodeURIComponent(selectedWorkspace) : ''}`);
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.is_public_scope) {
          isPublicScope = true;
          const tabs = document.getElementById('workspace-tabs');
          if (tabs) tabs.style.display = 'none';

          const strip = document.getElementById('overview-strip');
          if (strip) strip.style.display = 'none';

          const themeBtn = document.getElementById('theme-btn');
          if (themeBtn) themeBtn.style.display = 'none';

          document.title = 'OM Portal · Public Ingress';
          const sub = document.getElementById('portal-subtitle');
          if (sub) sub.textContent = 'Public Portal';

          const gridTitle = document.getElementById('grid-header-title');
          if (gridTitle) gridTitle.textContent = 'Public Services';

          const countEl = document.getElementById('service-count');
          if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${data.total_running} Online`;

          return;
        }

        registeredWorkspaces = data.workspaces || [];

        // Update Overview Stats
        const statWs = document.getElementById('stat-workspaces');
        const statWsSub = document.getElementById('stat-workspaces-sub');
        if (statWs) statWs.textContent = `${registeredWorkspaces.length}`;
        if (statWsSub) statWsSub.textContent = registeredWorkspaces.map(w => w.name).join(', ') || 'Isolated Environments';

        // Check if on a scoped subdomain URL
        if (isScopedSubdomain) {
          // Resolve fuzzy match (e.g. container -> containers)
          const matchedWs = registeredWorkspaces.find(w =>
            w.id === detectedWorkspaceId ||
            w.id.startsWith(detectedWorkspaceId) ||
            detectedWorkspaceId.startsWith(w.id) ||
            w.id.replace(/s$/, '') === detectedWorkspaceId.replace(/s$/, '')
          );

          if (matchedWs) {
            selectedWorkspace = matchedWs.id;
            document.title = `om · ${matchedWs.name} Workspace`;
            document.getElementById('portal-title').innerHTML = `OM <span style="font-weight:400; opacity:0.65; font-size:0.85em;">· ${escHtml(matchedWs.name)}</span>`;
            document.getElementById('portal-subtitle').textContent = `Workspace Capsule · ${matchedWs.id}`;
            document.getElementById('scoped-workspace-banner').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('scoped-name').textContent = matchedWs.name;
            document.getElementById('scoped-path').textContent = `${matchedWs.path || matchedWs.id} · Ingress: Port ${matchedWs.http_port || 80}`;
            document.getElementById('workspace-tabs').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('overview-strip').style.display = 'none';
            return;
          }
        }

        // Universal Dashboard Mode: Render sleek Segmented Control
        const tabsContainer = document.getElementById('workspace-tabs');
        if (!tabsContainer) return;
        tabsContainer.style.display = 'flex';
        tabsContainer.innerHTML = '';

        // "Universal (All)" Pill
        const totalRunning = data.total_running || allLoadedServices.filter(s => s.state === 'running').length;
        const allPill = document.createElement('button');
        allPill.dataset.wsId = 'all';
        allPill.className = 'ws-pill' + (selectedWorkspace === 'all' ? ' active' : '');
        allPill.innerHTML = `<span>🌐 Universal</span><span class="ws-pill-badge">${escHtml(totalRunning)} Online</span>`;
        allPill.onclick = async () => {
          selectedWorkspace = 'all';
          document.title = 'OM Portal · Universal Substrate';
          document.getElementById('portal-title').textContent = 'OM Portal';
          document.getElementById('portal-subtitle').textContent = 'Universal Substrate';
          updateWorkspacePills();
          renderServices();
          await loadSavedWallpaper();
        };
        tabsContainer.appendChild(allPill);

        // Per-Workspace Pills
        registeredWorkspaces.forEach(ws => {
          const pill = document.createElement('button');
          pill.dataset.wsId = ws.id;
          pill.className = 'ws-pill' + (selectedWorkspace === ws.id ? ' active' : '');
          pill.innerHTML = `<span>📁 ${escHtml(ws.name)}</span><span class="ws-pill-badge">${escHtml(ws.running)} Online</span>`;
          pill.onclick = async () => {
            selectedWorkspace = ws.id;
            document.title = `om · ${ws.name} Workspace`;
            document.getElementById('portal-title').innerHTML = `OM <span style="font-weight:400; opacity:0.65; font-size:0.85em;">· ${escHtml(ws.name)}</span>`;
            document.getElementById('portal-subtitle').textContent = `Workspace Capsule · ${ws.id}`;
            updateWorkspacePills();
            renderServices();
            await loadSavedWallpaper();
          };
          tabsContainer.appendChild(pill);
        });

      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Failed to load workspaces:', err);
      }
    }

    function updateWorkspacePills() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.ws-pill').forEach(pill => {
        pill.classList.toggle('active', pill.dataset.wsId === selectedWorkspace);
      });
    }

    // ── Render Services Bento Grid ──
    function renderServices() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('services-grid');
      const activeBadge = document.getElementById('active-badge');
      const serviceCountEl = document.getElementById('service-count');
      const statRunning = document.getElementById('stat-running');
      if (!grid) return;

      let services = allLoadedServices;
      if (selectedWorkspace !== 'all') {
        services = allLoadedServices.filter(s => {
          const sid = (s.workspace_id || '').toLowerCase();
          return sid === selectedWorkspace;
        });
      }

      const runningCount = services.filter(s => s.state === 'running').length;
      const totalCount = services.length;

      // Compute Total RAM across running workloads
      let totalMemBytes = 0;
      services.forEach(s => {
        if (s.state === 'running' && s.memory_usage) {
          totalMemBytes += s.memory_usage;
        }
      });
      const totalMemStr = totalMemBytes > 0
        ? (totalMemBytes >= 1024**3
            ? `${(totalMemBytes / (1024**3)).toFixed(2)} GB RAM`
            : `${(totalMemBytes / (1024**2)).toFixed(1)} MB RAM`)
        : 'Active & Healthy';

      // Update Header Badges & Metrics
      if (isPublicScope) {
        if (activeBadge) activeBadge.textContent = `${runningCount} Available`;
        if (serviceCountEl) serviceCountEl.textContent = `${runningCount} Online`;
      } else {
        if (activeBadge) activeBadge.textContent = `${runningCount}/${totalCount} Online`;
        if (serviceCountEl) serviceCountEl.textContent = `${runningCount} Online • ${totalCount} Total`;
        if (statRunning) statRunning.textContent = `${runningCount} / ${totalCount}`;
        const statRunningSub = document.getElementById('stat-running-sub');
        if (statRunningSub) statRunningSub.textContent = `Total: ${totalMemStr}`;
      }

      grid.innerHTML = '';
      if (services.length === 0) {
        const noResultsDesc = document.querySelector('#no-results p');
        if (noResultsDesc) {
          noResultsDesc.textContent = isPublicScope ? 'No public services are currently available on this network.' : 'Try a different keyword or switch workspaces using the tabs above.';
        }
        document.getElementById('no-results').style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('no-results').style.display = 'none';

      services.forEach(svc => {
        const isRunning = svc.state === 'running';
        const isCrashed = svc.state === 'exited' && svc.exit_code !== 0;
        const hasWeb = svc.has_web !== false;
        const serviceUrl = getServiceUrl(svc);
        const isClickable = isRunning && hasWeb && serviceUrl;

        const card = document.createElement(isClickable ? 'a' : 'div');
        card.className = 'service-card' + (!isRunning ? ' offline' : '') + (!hasWeb ? ' daemon-service' : '');
        if (isClickable) {
          card.href = serviceUrl;
          card.target = '_blank';
          card.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
        }

        let tag = svc.is_public ? 'Public Web' : 'Private Web';
        if (!hasWeb) {
          tag = 'system daemon';
        }

        let stateClass = 'state-running';
        let stateLabel = 'running';
        let stateIcon = '🟢';
        if (!isRunning) {
          if (isCrashed) {
            stateClass = 'state-crashed'; stateLabel = `crashed (${svc.exit_code})`; stateIcon = '⚠️';
          } else if (svc.state === 'paused') {
            stateClass = 'state-paused'; stateLabel = 'paused'; stateIcon = '⏸';
          } else {
            stateClass = 'state-exited'; stateLabel = svc.state || 'stopped'; stateIcon = '⏹';
          }
        }

        const wsPill = (!isPublicScope && svc.workspace_id) ? `<span class="card-ws-pill">📁 ${escHtml(svc.workspace_id)}</span>` : '';

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="card-top">
            <div class="card-icon-title">
              <div class="card-icon-box">${escHtml(svc.icon || '📦')}</div>
              <div>
                <div class="card-name">${escHtml(svc.name)}</div>
                <span class="live-status ${escHtml(stateClass)}">${escHtml(stateIcon)} ${escHtml(stateLabel)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            ${wsPill}
          </div>
          <div class="card-desc">${escHtml(svc.description || 'Self-hosted service')}</div>
          <div class="card-bottom">
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.45rem; flex-wrap:wrap;">
              <span class="card-tag">${escHtml(tag)}</span>
              ${!isPublicScope && isRunning && svc.memory_str && svc.memory_str !== '—' ? `<span class="card-ram-pill" title="Live Container RAM">💾 ${escHtml(svc.memory_str)}</span>` : ''}
              ${!isPublicScope && svc.update_available ? `<span class="card-ram-pill" title="A newer image exists. In the workspace folder: om update --dry-run, then om update">⬆ update</span>` : ''}
            </div>
            ${isClickable ? '<span class="card-arrow">↗</span>' : ''}
          </div>
        `;
        grid.appendChild(card);
      });

      const currentQ = document.getElementById('search-input')?.value;
      if (currentQ) filterServices(currentQ);
    }

    // ── Dedicated Live Container Filter ──
    function filterServices(query) {
      const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.service-card');
      let visible = 0;
      cards.forEach(card => {
        const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
        if (text.includes(q)) {
          card.style.display = 'flex';
          visible++;
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
      document.getElementById('no-results').style.display = visible === 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    // ── Construct Precise RFC 6761 URLs ──
    function getServiceUrl(svc) {
      if (svc.url) return /^(https?:\/\/|\/(?!\/))/i.test(svc.url) ? svc.url : null;
      if (svc.has_web === false) return null;

      const ws = svc.workspace_id || '';
      const key = svc.key || svc.name.toLowerCase();

      const curHost = window.location.hostname;
      if (curHost.endsWith('.localhost') || curHost === 'localhost' || curHost === '127.0.0.1') {
        const port = window.location.port ? `:${window.location.port}` : '';  // OM_HTTP_PORT when not 80
        if (svc.domain) return `http://${svc.domain}${port}/`;
        return ws ? `http://${ws}.${key}.localhost${port}/` : `http://${key}.localhost${port}/`;
      }

      // VPN or LAN: the service's own port, so its own origin (never a path on this one)
      const port = isPublicScope ? svc.port_public : svc.port_private;
      if (!port) return null;
      const host = curHost.includes(':') ? `[${curHost}]` : curHost;
      const path = (svc.path || '/').startsWith('/') ? (svc.path || '/') : `/${svc.path}`;
      return `http://${host}:${port}${path}`;
    }

    // ── Fetch Services ──
    async function loadServices() {
      try {
        const endpoint = `/api/services${selectedWorkspace !== 'all' ? '?workspace=' + encodeURIComponent(selectedWorkspace) : ''}`;
        const res = await fetch(endpoint);
        if (!res.ok) return;
        allLoadedServices = await res.json();
        renderServices();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load services:", err);
      }
    }

    // ── Independent Wallpaper & Visuals Studio (Decoupled from Cards) ──
    function syncSlidersToSettings(settings) {
      if (!settings) return;
      const bVal = (settings.blur !== undefined && settings.blur !== null) ? parseInt(settings.blur, 10) : 0;
      const dVal = (settings.dim !== undefined && settings.dim !== null) ? parseInt(settings.dim, 10) : 20;
      const cbVal = (settings.card_blur !== undefined && settings.card_blur !== null) ? parseInt(settings.card_blur, 10) : 16;
      const cdVal = (settings.card_dim !== undefined && settings.card_dim !== null) ? parseInt(settings.card_dim, 10) : 65;

      const bSlider = document.getElementById('blur-slider');
      const dSlider = document.getElementById('dim-slider');
      const cbSlider = document.getElementById('card-blur-slider');
      const cdSlider = document.getElementById('card-dim-slider');

      if (bSlider) { bSlider.value = bVal; const el = document.getElementById('blur-val'); if (el) el.textContent = `${bVal}px`; }
      if (dSlider) { dSlider.value = dVal; const el = document.getElementById('dim-val'); if (el) el.textContent = `${dVal}%`; }
      if (cbSlider) { cbSlider.value = cbVal; const el = document.getElementById('card-blur-val'); if (el) el.textContent = `${cbVal}px`; }
      if (cdSlider) { cdSlider.value = cdVal; const el = document.getElementById('card-dim-val'); if (el) el.textContent = `${cdVal}%`; }
    }

    function safeWallpaperUrl(url) {
      if (!url) return null;
      if (url.startsWith('/api/wallpaper/') || url.startsWith('blob:')) {
        return url;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function applyVisuals(url, blur, dim, cardBlur, cardDim, updateInputs = false) {
      const wpLayer = document.getElementById('wallpaper-layer');
      if (wpLayer) {
        const safeUrl = safeWallpaperUrl(url);
        if (safeUrl) {
          wpLayer.style.backgroundImage = `url("${safeUrl}")`;
        } else if (url === null || url === '') {
          wpLayer.style.backgroundImage = 'none';
        }
      }
      if (blur !== undefined && blur !== null) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--wp-blur', `${blur}px`);
        if (updateInputs) {
          const s = document.getElementById('blur-slider');
          const v = document.getElementById('blur-val');
          if (s) s.value = blur;
          if (v) v.textContent = `${blur}px`;
        }
      }
      if (dim !== undefined && dim !== null) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--wp-dim', (dim / 100).toFixed(2));
        if (updateInputs) {
          const s = document.getElementById('dim-slider');
          const v = document.getElementById('dim-val');
          if (s) s.value = dim;
          if (v) v.textContent = `${dim}%`;
        }
      }
      if (cardBlur !== undefined && cardBlur !== null) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--card-blur', `${cardBlur}px`);
        if (updateInputs) {
          const s = document.getElementById('card-blur-slider');
          const v = document.getElementById('card-blur-val');
          if (s) s.value = cardBlur;
          if (v) v.textContent = `${cardBlur}px`;
        }
      }
      if (cardDim !== undefined && cardDim !== null) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--card-dim', (cardDim / 100).toFixed(2));
        if (updateInputs) {
          const s = document.getElementById('card-dim-slider');
          const v = document.getElementById('card-dim-val');
          if (s) s.value = cardDim;
          if (v) v.textContent = `${cardDim}%`;
        }
      }
    }

    async function loadSavedWallpaper() {
      try {
        const wsParam = (selectedWorkspace && selectedWorkspace !== 'all') ? `?workspace=${encodeURIComponent(selectedWorkspace)}` : '';
        const res = await fetch(`/api/wallpaper/settings${wsParam}`);
        if (!res.ok) return;
        savedSettings = await res.json();
        
        savedSettings.blur = (savedSettings.blur !== undefined && savedSettings.blur !== null) ? parseInt(savedSettings.blur, 10) : 0;
        savedSettings.dim = (savedSettings.dim !== undefined && savedSettings.dim !== null) ? parseInt(savedSettings.dim, 10) : 20;
        savedSettings.card_blur = (savedSettings.card_blur !== undefined && savedSettings.card_blur !== null) ? parseInt(savedSettings.card_blur, 10) : 16;
        savedSettings.card_dim = (savedSettings.card_dim !== undefined && savedSettings.card_dim !== null) ? parseInt(savedSettings.card_dim, 10) : 65;

        const t = savedSettings.timestamp || Date.now();
        const sep = wsParam ? '&' : '?';
        applyVisuals(
          `/api/wallpaper/current${wsParam}${sep}t=${t}`,
          savedSettings.blur,
          savedSettings.dim,
          savedSettings.card_blur,
          savedSettings.card_dim,
          true
        );
        updateStatusLabel();
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Failed to load wallpaper settings:', e);
      }
    }

    function updateStatusLabel() {
      const el = document.getElementById('footer-status-label');
      if (!el) return;
      if (previewState) {
        el.textContent = `Staged: ${previewState.name}`;
        el.style.color = '#38bdf8';
      } else {
        el.textContent = `Active: ${savedSettings.name || 'Current Wallpaper'}`;
        el.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
      }
    }

    function updateBlur(val) {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--wp-blur', `${val}px`);
      const el = document.getElementById('blur-val');
      if (el) el.textContent = `${val}px`;
    }
    function updateDim(val) {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--wp-dim', (val / 100).toFixed(2));
      const el = document.getElementById('dim-val');
      if (el) el.textContent = `${val}%`;
    }
    function updateCardBlur(val) {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--card-blur', `${val}px`);
      const el = document.getElementById('card-blur-val');
      if (el) el.textContent = `${val}px`;
    }
    function updateCardDim(val) {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--card-dim', (val / 100).toFixed(2));
      const el = document.getElementById('card-dim-val');
      if (el) el.textContent = `${val}%`;
    }

    function openWallpaperModal() {
      document.getElementById('wallpaper-dialog').showModal();
      loadPresetsList();
      syncSlidersToSettings(savedSettings);
      updateStatusLabel();
    }

    function closeWallpaperModal(revert = false) {
      if (revert) {
        const wsParam = (selectedWorkspace && selectedWorkspace !== 'all') ? `?workspace=${encodeURIComponent(selectedWorkspace)}` : '';
        const sep = wsParam ? '&' : '?';
        const t = savedSettings.timestamp || Date.now();
        applyVisuals(
          savedSettings.name ? `/api/wallpaper/current${wsParam}${sep}t=${t}` : null,
          savedSettings.blur,
          savedSettings.dim,
          savedSettings.card_blur,
          savedSettings.card_dim,
          true
        );
      }
      previewState = null;
      document.querySelectorAll('.preset-thumb').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      document.getElementById('wallpaper-dialog').close();
    }

    async function loadPresetsList() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('presets-grid');
      if (!grid) return;
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/wallpapers');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        (data.wallpapers || []).slice(0, 48).forEach(wp => {
          const div = document.createElement('div');
          div.className = 'preset-thumb' + (savedSettings && savedSettings.name === wp ? ' active' : '');
          div.title = wp;
          div.innerHTML = `<img src="/api/wallpaper/preview_host?path=${encodeURIComponent(wp)}" loading="lazy" alt="${escHtml(wp)}" />`;
          div.onclick = () => {
            document.querySelectorAll('.preset-thumb').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
            div.classList.add('active');
            startPreview('name', wp, `/api/wallpaper/preview_host?path=${encodeURIComponent(wp)}`, wp);
          };
          grid.appendChild(div);
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn(e);
      }
    }

    function startPreview(type, data, previewUrl, name) {
      previewState = { type, data, previewUrl, name };
      const bSlider = document.getElementById('blur-slider');
      const dSlider = document.getElementById('dim-slider');
      const cbSlider = document.getElementById('card-blur-slider');
      const cdSlider = document.getElementById('card-dim-slider');

      const curBlur = bSlider ? parseInt(bSlider.value, 10) : savedSettings.blur;
      const curDim = dSlider ? parseInt(dSlider.value, 10) : savedSettings.dim;
      const curCardBlur = cbSlider ? parseInt(cbSlider.value, 10) : savedSettings.card_blur;
      const curCardDim = cdSlider ? parseInt(cdSlider.value, 10) : savedSettings.card_dim;

      applyVisuals(previewUrl, curBlur, curDim, curCardBlur, curCardDim, false);
      updateStatusLabel();
    }

    async function confirmApplyWallpaper() {
      const saveBtn = document.getElementById('btn-save-appearance');
      if (saveBtn) {
        saveBtn.disabled = true;
        saveBtn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span><span>Saving…</span>';
      }

      const bSlider = document.getElementById('blur-slider');
      const dSlider = document.getElementById('dim-slider');
      const cbSlider = document.getElementById('card-blur-slider');
      const cdSlider = document.getElementById('card-dim-slider');

      const blur = bSlider ? parseInt(bSlider.value, 10) : (savedSettings.blur !== undefined ? savedSettings.blur : 0);
      const dim = dSlider ? parseInt(dSlider.value, 10) : (savedSettings.dim !== undefined ? savedSettings.dim : 20);
      const card_blur = cbSlider ? parseInt(cbSlider.value, 10) : (savedSettings.card_blur !== undefined ? savedSettings.card_blur : 16);
      const card_dim = cdSlider ? parseInt(cdSlider.value, 10) : (savedSettings.card_dim !== undefined ? savedSettings.card_dim : 65);

      const targetWs = (selectedWorkspace && selectedWorkspace !== 'all') ? selectedWorkspace : null;
      const wsQuery = targetWs ? `&workspace=${encodeURIComponent(targetWs)}` : '';

      try {
        let newTimestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
        let newName = (previewState && previewState.name) ? previewState.name : (savedSettings.name || 'wallpaper.png');

        if (previewState && previewState.type === 'file') {
          const res = await fetch(`/api/wallpaper/upload?blur=${blur}&dim=${dim}&card_blur=${card_blur}&card_dim=${card_dim}&name=${encodeURIComponent(previewState.name)}${wsQuery}`, {
            method: 'POST',
            body: previewState.data
          });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Upload failed: " + res.statusText);
          const json = await res.json();
          newTimestamp = json.timestamp || newTimestamp;
        } else if (previewState && (previewState.type === 'path' || previewState.type === 'name')) {
          const payload = {
            blur, dim, card_blur, card_dim,
            workspace: targetWs
          };
          if (previewState.type === 'path') payload.path = previewState.data;
          if (previewState.type === 'name') payload.name = previewState.data;

          const res = await fetch('/api/wallpaper/set', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
          });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Apply wallpaper failed: " + res.statusText);
          const json = await res.json();
          newTimestamp = json.timestamp || newTimestamp;
        } else {
          // No image change staged; update slider visual settings only
          const res = await fetch('/api/wallpaper/settings', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ blur, dim, card_blur, card_dim, workspace: targetWs })
          });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Save settings failed: " + res.statusText);
          const json = await res.json();
          newTimestamp = json.timestamp || newTimestamp;
        }

        savedSettings = {
          name: newName,
          blur,
          dim,
          card_blur,
          card_dim,
          timestamp: newTimestamp,
          workspace_id: targetWs || 'core'
        };

        const wsParam = targetWs ? `?workspace=${encodeURIComponent(targetWs)}` : '';
        const sep = wsParam ? '&' : '?';
        applyVisuals(`/api/wallpaper/current${wsParam}${sep}t=${newTimestamp}`, blur, dim, card_blur, card_dim, true);

        previewState = null;
        updateStatusLabel();
        document.getElementById('wallpaper-dialog').close();
      } catch (err) {
        alert("Failed to save appearance: " + (err.message || err));
      } finally {
        if (saveBtn) {
          saveBtn.disabled = false;
          saveBtn.innerHTML = '<span>💾</span><span>Apply & Save Appearance</span>';
        }
      }
    }

    function optimizeImageFile(file, maxWidth = 2560, maxHeight = 1440) {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const img = new Image();
        img.onload = () => {
          let { width, height } = img;
          if (width > maxWidth || height > maxHeight) {
            const ratio = Math.min(maxWidth / width, maxHeight / height);
            width = Math.round(width * ratio);
            height = Math.round(height * ratio);
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = width;
            canvas.height = height;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
            canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
              resolve(blob || file);
            }, 'image/jpeg', 0.88);
            return;
          }
          resolve(file);
        };
        img.onerror = () => resolve(file);
        img.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      });
    }

    async function handleSystemFile(e) {
      let file = null;
      if (e.target && e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
        file = e.target.files[0];
      } else if (e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
        file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
      }
      if (!file) return;
      const optimizedBlob = await optimizeImageFile(file);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(optimizedBlob);
      startPreview('file', optimizedBlob, url, file.name);
    }

    function loadHostPath() {
      const val = document.getElementById('host-path-input').value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      const previewUrl = `/api/wallpaper/preview_host?path=${encodeURIComponent(val)}`;
      startPreview('path', val, previewUrl, val.split('/').pop());
    }

    // ── Fetch System & Platform Stats ──
    async function loadSystemStats() {
      if (isPublicScope) return;
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/system');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();
        const statPlatformRam = document.getElementById('stat-platform-ram');
        const statPlatformSub = document.getElementById('stat-platform-sub');
        if (statPlatformRam && data.platform_ram_str) {
          statPlatformRam.textContent = `${data.platform_ram_str} RAM`;
          statPlatformRam.title = data.platform_ram_cache_free ? 'Anonymous memory of the core containers (file cache excluded)' : 'As reported by the engine, including file cache';
        }
        if (statPlatformSub && data.platform_containers) {
          const names = data.platform_containers.map(c => c.name.replace(/^om_/, '')).join(' + ');
          statPlatformSub.textContent = names ? `${names.toUpperCase()} Core` : 'Core Ingress & UI';
          statPlatformSub.title = data.platform_containers.map(c => `${c.name}: ${c.memory_str}`).join(' | ');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load system stats:", err);
      }
    }

    // ── Zen Mode Toggle ──
    function toggleZenMode() {
      document.body.classList.toggle('zen-mode');
      const isZen = document.body.classList.contains('zen-mode');
      document.getElementById('zen-icon').textContent = isZen ? '🕶️' : '👁️';
    }

    // ── Initialize (Concurrent Parallel Loading) ──
    async function init() {
      const dropzone = document.querySelector('.dropzone-box');
      if (dropzone) {
        dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          dropzone.classList.add('dragover');
        });
        dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
          dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
        });
        dropzone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
          handleSystemFile(e);
        });
      }

      await loadWorkspaces();
      await Promise.all([loadServices(), loadSavedWallpaper(), loadSystemStats()]);
      setInterval(() => {
        loadServices();
        if (!isPublicScope) loadSystemStats();
      }, 3000);
    }

    // Handlers are bound here, not inline, so the CSP can forbid inline script attributes.
    function bindHandlers() {
      const on = (id, ev, fn) => document.getElementById(id).addEventListener(ev, fn);
      on('search-input', 'input', e => filterServices(e.target.value));
      on('search-input', 'keydown', handleSearchKey);
      on('theme-btn', 'click', () => openWallpaperModal());
      on('zen-btn', 'click', () => toggleZenMode());
      on('wp-close-btn', 'click', () => closeWallpaperModal(true));
      on('wp-cancel-btn', 'click', () => closeWallpaperModal(true));
      on('wp-dropzone', 'click', () => document.getElementById('system-file-input').click());
      on('system-file-input', 'change', handleSystemFile);
      on('host-path-input', 'keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') loadHostPath(); });
      on('wp-load-btn', 'click', () => loadHostPath());
      on('card-blur-slider', 'input', e => updateCardBlur(e.target.value));
      on('card-dim-slider', 'input', e => updateCardDim(e.target.value));
      on('blur-slider', 'input', e => updateBlur(e.target.value));
      on('dim-slider', 'input', e => updateDim(e.target.value));
      on('btn-save-appearance', 'click', () => confirmApplyWallpaper());
    }
    bindHandlers();
    init();
  </script>
